cwe_descriptions: CWE-214: Invocation of Process Using Visible Sensitive Information — A process is invoked with sensitive command-line arguments, environment variables, or other elements that can be seen by other processes on the operating system.
CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption — The product does not properly control the allocation and maintenance of a limited resource.
CWE-668: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere — The product exposes a resource to the wrong control sphere, providing unintended actors with inappropriate access to the resource.
